name: halftone-diamond-mesh
title: Halftone Diamond Mesh
description: Rhombus diamond-shaped screen printing halftone dots scaled across a diagonal angle matrix.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Condensed
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Diamond Halftone: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
